key_insight: ROGUE-AI shows that agents can cause harm without an attacker by following tasks while overlooking ordinary operational hazards.
engineering_relevance: Engineering teams can use incident-based replications and matched controls to audit agent releases, including failures that prompt-injection defenses do not address.
method: Rebuild reported incidents offline using a multi-agent framework.
Compare each incident with a matched control lacking only the blamed cause.
Test agent behavior and compare hazard-specific warnings with same-length generic notes.
evidence_signal: Across 108 attempted replications, 89% reproduced reported harm; agents using five models made the reported mistake in 18–33% of runs versus at most 1% in matched controls.
watch_item: Offline reconstructions may not capture every production condition, so matched-control findings need validation in deployment-specific environments.
paper_title: Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation (ROGUE-AI)
